script: To sketch the velocity graph from a displacement graph, copy the same period and scale, then shift the displacement pattern forward by one quarter of a cycle for this lesson’s convention. First, draw the displacement curve with its equilibrium line, positive and negative extrema, and the marked period T = 0.60 s between corresponding positive maxima. At each positive displacement maximum, place velocity at zero because the oscillator is momentarily turning around. At each equilibrium crossing, place velocity at maximum magnitude, choosing positive when the displacement curve is rising and negative when it is falling. Connect those velocity points with a cosine-shaped curve that leads the displacement curve by T/4, as the on-screen note states. For the same example, the velocity amplitude is v₀ = ωx₀ = (10.5)(0.050) ≈ 0.525 m s⁻¹, so label the velocity peaks at approximately ±0.525 m s⁻¹. We will go deeper on combining these phase checks and equations in part 6, “Apply and interpret SHM.”

ops.teachingPoint: Create a fresh annotated paper-whiteboard composition with two vertically aligned, shared-time-axis plots from 0 to 1.4 s. In the upper plot, draw the student's displacement-time sine curve x with horizontal equilibrium line x = 0, vertical labels +0.050 m and −0.050 m, and mark successive positive maxima at 0.20 s and 0.80 s; annotate the bracket between them T = 0.60 s. In the lower plot, reveal the velocity curve v on the same time scale and with a clearly labelled vertical axis in m s⁻¹, using v0 = ωx0 ≈ 0.525 m s⁻¹. First annotate the upper positive displacement maxima and draw vertical guide lines down to zero crossings of v, labelled “turning point: v = 0”; next annotate each upper equilibrium crossing and draw guides to velocity extrema, labelling “x rising → v positive” and “x falling → v negative.” Draw the lower velocity curve as the corresponding cosine wave, with its positive maximum aligned one quarter period before each positive displacement maximum, and add a double-headed horizontal arrow labelled “v leads x by T/4 = 0.15 s.” Finish with a compact side annotation: “same T and f; use slope direction for sign,” plus a boxed note at a positive x maximum stating “v = 0, a = maximum negative,” connecting the graph-reading rule to the question on screen. Reveal these parts in the exact order described: displacement graph and extrema, period bracket, velocity zeros, equilibrium-to-velocity-extrema guides, connecting velocity curve, quarter-cycle lead annotation, then the final positive-maximum result.

export default function Animation({ sentence, sentenceProgress }) {
  const on = (k) => sentence >= k;
  const reveal = (k) => ({ opacity: on(k) ? 1 : 0, y: on(k) ? 0 : 10 });
  const draw = (k) => ({ pathLength: on(k) ? 1 : 0, opacity: on(k) ? 1 : 0 });
  const REVEAL = { duration: 0.6, ease: "easeOut" };
  const DRAW = { duration: 1.1, ease: "easeInOut" };
  const SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 140, damping: 24 };
  const GLIDE = { duration: 0.35, ease: "easeOut" };

  const visualSpec = {
    subject: "Simple harmonic oscillations",
    recognitionCues: ["shared time axis", "displacement and velocity curves", "quarter-cycle phase lead"],
    requiredParts: ["x(t)", "v(t)", "T = 0.60 s", "v₀ ≈ 0.525 m s⁻¹"],
    relationships: ["velocity leads displacement by T/4", "turning points have v = 0", "slope direction determines velocity sign"],
    morphology: "two vertically aligned coordinate plots",
    view: "shared-time-axis phase comparison",
    forbiddenShortcuts: ["generic icon", "unlabeled blob", "decorative geometry"]
  };

  const boardPlan = {
    composition: "two aligned plots centered in the content area, with shared horizontal time scale",
    readingPath: "heading → displacement curve → velocity checks → phase lead → result",
    reservedRegions: [
      { name: "title", x: 56, y: 30, w: 520, h: 43 },
      { name: "subtitle", x: 56, y: 84, w: 700, h: 27 },
      { name: "upperPlot", x: 175, y: 145, w: 735, h: 135 },
      { name: "lowerPlot", x: 175, y: 330, w: 735, h: 145 },
      { name: "note1", x: 56, y: 488, w: 280, h: 25 },
      { name: "note2", x: 350, y: 488, w: 270, h: 25 },
      { name: "note3", x: 635, y: 488, w: 300, h: 25 }
    ]
  };

  const X0 = 210, X1 = 900, scale = (X1 - X0) / 1.4;
  const tx = (t) => X0 + t * scale;
  const upper = (t) => 220 - 52 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * (t - 0.2)) / 0.6);
  const lower = (t) => 405 - 52 * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * (t - 0.05)) / 0.6);

  const upperPath = Array.from({ length: 141 }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / 100;
    return `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${tx(t)} ${upper(t)}`;
  }).join(" ");

  const lowerPath = Array.from({ length: 141 }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / 100;
    return `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${tx(t)} ${lower(t)}`;
  }).join(" ");

  const progress = smooth(sentenceProgress);
  const leadX = lerp(tx(0.05), tx(0.2), phase(sentenceProgress, 0.15, 0.85));

  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 560" role="img" aria-label="Simple harmonic oscillations">
      <defs>
        <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="4" floodColor="#0f172a" floodOpacity="0.14" />
        </filter>
        <linearGradient id="blueFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#eef6fd" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#d7e9f8" />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="roseFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#fdf0f4" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#f5d6df" />
        </linearGradient>
        <marker id="tealArrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="4.5" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0,0 L9,4.5 L0,9 Z" fill="#0f766e" />
        </marker>
        <marker id="amberArrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="4.5" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0,0 L9,4.5 L0,9 Z" fill="#d97706" />
        </marker>
      </defs>

      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="560" fill="#fbfbf8" />

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(0)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <text x="56" y="70" fontSize="32" fontWeight="800" fill="#1b2440">
          Simple harmonic oscillations
        </text>
        <text x="56" y="106" fontSize="20" fill="#5b6478">
          Reading velocity from displacement
        </text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(1)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <rect x="180" y="145" width="735" height="140" rx="14" fill="url(#blueFill)" stroke="#3f7cc0" strokeWidth="2.5" filter="url(#soft)" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="220" x2={X1} y2="220" stroke="#5b6478" strokeWidth="2" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="155" x2={X0} y2="282" stroke="#1b2440" strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="282" x2={X1} y2="282" stroke="#1b2440" strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <text x="188" y="166" fontSize="20" fontWeight="800" fill="#1b2440">x(t)</text>
        <text x="145" y="174" fontSize="17" fill="#3f7cc0">+0.050 m</text>
        <text x="145" y="275" fontSize="17" fill="#3f7cc0">−0.050 m</text>
        <text x="155" y="225" fontSize="17" fill="#5b6478">x = 0</text>
        <path d={upperPath} fill="none" stroke="#3f7cc0" strokeWidth="4" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(1)} transition={{ ...REVEAL, delay: 0.35 }}>
        <circle cx={tx(0.2)} cy={upper(0.2)} r="7" fill="#d97706" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="3" />
        <circle cx={tx(0.8)} cy={upper(0.8)} r="7" fill="#d97706" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="3" />
        <text x={tx(0.2) - 18} y="173" fontSize="16" fill="#d97706">0.20 s</text>
        <text x={tx(0.8) - 18} y="173" fontSize="16" fill="#d97706">0.80 s</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(1)} transition={{ ...REVEAL, delay: 0.7 }}>
        <path d={`M ${tx(0.2)} 188 V 180 M ${tx(0.2)} 184 H ${tx(0.8)} M ${tx(0.8)} 180 V 188`}
          fill="none" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
        <text x={(tx(0.2) + tx(0.8)) / 2 - 38} y="167" fontSize="18" fill="#d97706">T = 0.60 s</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(2)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <line x1={tx(0.2)} y1={upper(0.2) + 9} x2={tx(0.2)} y2="405" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="6 6" />
        <line x1={tx(0.8)} y1={upper(0.8) + 9} x2={tx(0.8)} y2="405" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="6 6" />
        <circle cx={tx(0.2)} cy="405" r="6" fill="#d97706" />
        <circle cx={tx(0.8)} cy="405" r="6" fill="#d97706" />
        <text x="706" y="312" fontSize="18" fill="#be123c">turning point: v = 0</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(3)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <line x1={tx(0.35)} y1={220} x2={tx(0.35)} y2={353} stroke="#0f766e" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="5 5" />
        <line x1={tx(0.65)} y1={220} x2={tx(0.65)} y2={457} stroke="#0f766e" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="5 5" />
        <circle cx={tx(0.35)} cy={upper(0.35)} r="6" fill="#0f766e" />
        <circle cx={tx(0.65)} cy={upper(0.65)} r="6" fill="#0f766e" />
        <text x="390" y="345" fontSize="17" fill="#0f766e">x rising → v positive</text>
        <text x="518" y="468" fontSize="17" fill="#0f766e">x falling → v negative</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(4)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <rect x="180" y="330" width="735" height="145" rx="14" fill="url(#roseFill)" stroke="#be123c" strokeWidth="2.5" filter="url(#soft)" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="405" x2={X1} y2="405" stroke="#5b6478" strokeWidth="2" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="340" x2={X0} y2="468" stroke="#1b2440" strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <line x1={X0} y1="468" x2={X1} y2="468" stroke="#1b2440" strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <text x="188" y="350" fontSize="20" fontWeight="800" fill="#1b2440">v(t)</text>
        <text x="92" y="354" fontSize="16" fill="#be123c">+0.525 m s⁻¹</text>
        <text x="92" y="465" fontSize="16" fill="#be123c">−0.525 m s⁻¹</text>
        <path d={lowerPath} fill="none" stroke="#be123c" strokeWidth="4" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(5)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <path d={`M ${tx(0.05)} 505 H ${tx(0.2)}`} fill="none" stroke="#0f766e" strokeWidth="3"
          markerStart="url(#tealArrow)" markerEnd="url(#tealArrow)" />
        <text x={tx(0.05) + 24} y="528" fontSize="18" fill="#0f766e">v leads x by T/4 = 0.15 s</text>
        <motion.circle
          initial={false}
          animate={{ cx: on(5) ? tx(0.2) : leadX, cy: on(5) ? 405 : lower(0.05), opacity: on(5) ? 0 : 1 }}
          transition={GLIDE}
          r="6"
          fill="#0f766e"
        />
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(6)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <rect x="618" y="118" width="292" height="42" rx="12" fill="#fdf2e9" stroke="#ea8a2e" strokeWidth="2" />
        <text x="634" y="145" fontSize="17" fill="#1b2440">v = 0, a = maximum negative</text>
      </motion.g>

      <motion.g initial={false} animate={reveal(6)} transition={REVEAL}>
        <circle cx="63" cy="500" r="5" fill="#3f7cc0" />
        <text x="78" y="507" fontSize="19" fontWeight="600" fill="#1b2440">same T and f</text>
        <circle cx="310" cy="500" r="5" fill="#0f766e" />
        <text x="325" y="507" fontSize="19" fontWeight="600" fill="#1b2440">slope gives sign</text>
        <circle cx="582" cy="500" r="5" fill="#d97706" />
        <text x="597" y="507" fontSize="19" fontWeight="600" fill="#1b2440">v₀ = ωx₀ ≈ 0.525</text>
      </motion.g>

      <BoardLabels sentence={sentence} sentenceProgress={sentenceProgress} labels={[]} />
    </svg>
  );
}
